titel: Calm Music For Anxiety, Stress Relief, Meditation, Sleep, Study and Relaxation | Episode 14

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Updates on series 2, new projects, and ways to support the channel.
kurzfassung: Andy Keene thanks listeners for reaching over 122,000 downloads in 77 countries since the launch of the Relaxation Channel. He announces that series 2 will begin on Thursday, May 14, 2020, and introduces an upcoming guided meditation podcast. Listeners can support the channel through donations to receive exclusive content and early access.
stichpunkte: Launch of the Relaxation Channel in March 2020 with significant growth
Series 2 starts on Thursday, May 14, 2020, airing weekly on Thursdays
Upcoming launch of a new channel called Guided Meditation
New website relaxingchannel.com launched without advertisements
Plans to potentially create a Facebook group for listener community interaction
Donation tier of $10 or more offers exclusive content, early access, and a supporters wall shoutout
Additional support requested through reviews on iTunes, Stitcher, and other platforms

clips.text: The host expresses gratitude for the strong listener turnout since the channel started in March, noting high download numbers across numerous countries.

clips.hook: Series 2 and a new guided meditation channel
clips.text: Announcements are made regarding the upcoming Thursday release schedule for series 2 and the future introduction of a dedicated meditation podcast.

clips.hook: Building a community space for listeners
clips.text: A listener suggestion leads to the consideration of creating a Facebook group so audience members can connect and chat with each other.

clips.hook: Founding supporter perks for a $10 donation
clips.text: Financial contributors receive an accompanying stress management audio package along with series 1 and series 2 perks by visiting the official website.

beschreibung:
Calm Music For Anxiety, Stress Relief, Meditation, Sleep, Study and Relaxation.
Music helps you to relax your mind and body to recharge you with positive energy. If you are suffering from anxiety or stress this music will help to calm your mind. Meditation music will help you to drift away. The music is good for studying, reading, and if you cannot fall asleep.

Find somewhere quiet and comfortable, then drift away. The best option is to use earbuds or better headphones if available.
Please visit our website www.relaxingchannel.com
